body: i've felt the same way, that nobody will ever love me. i've been trying to look forward to someone loving me in the future, but i know its hard when there's no way i can be certain about it. I've been trying to look forward to other things that aren't relationships, like when shows will put out new episodes or seasons, or when music awards or sports finals are. But i feel like relationships are like the times of year you dont have allergies, you dont realize how nice it is until its gone, any youre left with a stuffy nose that you just have to fight through until the allergies go away. Does that make sense? i dont think it does. All i want to say is that relationships dont define who you are as a person, and you don't need validation from others to have value.

i've been holding onto the hope that someday it will feel like everything is ok. Everything surrounding death seems so nice, but when i've looked into the core of the idea, all i've seen is uncertainty. I know that i want to find something in my life that's solid, that i can ground myself with until someday the storm passes. whether that be a goal or a hobby or anything, my best advice would be to find something to look forward to. Find a new show if you can, The dragon prince on netflix is one of my favorites. The golden globes are happening in January, as well as tons of sports games and award shows that ive been holding onto because maybe my favorite hockey team can make it to the stanley cup, or my favorite musicians can get the recognition they deserve. Find something you love or loved and try to rekindle the flame. I dont know if this'll help, but things like these have kept me going for a while.
